description: Regression target for canonical-enum validation in extract_instrument.py. Captures the failure mode where a model produces a descriptively-correct but non-canonical SAFE form enum string. Anonymized from a real audit case (Sprint 1.7, one of 17 such cases).
source_excerpt: The "Discount Rate" is 80%. The "Post-Money Valuation Cap" is US$ 20,000,000.

non_canonical_extraction.evidence_quote: The "Discount Rate" is 80%. The "Post-Money Valuation Cap" is US$ 20,000,000.
non_canonical_extraction._note: Value is descriptively correct — the document IS a post-money SAFE with both a cap and a discount. But the enum string is not in the canonical SAFE_FORM_GATES set in extract_instrument.py.

canonical_extraction.evidence_quote: The "Discount Rate" is 80%. The "Post-Money Valuation Cap" is US$ 20,000,000.

schema_enum_validation.rule: extract_instrument.py must reject any SAFE label whose form.value is not in canonical_enum_values. The extractor should either auto-remap (per remap_table) and emit a warning, or hard-reject and re-prompt.

field_consistency_check.rule: For form='cap_plus_discount': post_money_valuation_cap AND discount_multiplier must both be non-null; pre_money_valuation_cap must be null.
field_consistency_check.expected_on_both_extractions_with_fields: PASS (the enum string differs but the underlying data matches the canonical form's gates)
